resid-plane-text: The crest angle is arctan(Δh/s) and nothing else. On this case it misses by {a}′ with the almanac's refraction correction off, {b}′ with it on.

resid-note: Refraction is not what decides this. It moves both models by roughly the same amount and never closes the gap between them, because that gap is s/2R and no refraction term contains it.
